01 — UI/UX
FuelMe
Food Delivery App · UX Design
The Brief

Design a full food delivery app for Malaysians — fast, local, and accessible. From splash screen to order history, every flow built from scratch.

The Problem

Existing apps don't cater to the diversity of Malaysian hawker culture. Users struggle to discover local favourites and navigate multi-restaurant orders.

The Solution

A clean dual-mode interface — Delivery, Dine-In, Pick-Up — with cuisine category filters, real-time delivery tracking, and a modular cart supporting multiple restaurants.
